title: TikTok profile scraper (Apify clockworks/tiktok-scraper · profiles flow)
description: User input arrives as an A2UI form (control surface); an XState machine then, per profile, emits the author, dispatches A2UI loadMore until resultsPerPage tiles are projected, and opens/emits/closes each video — every page interaction is an A2UI action on the projected surface.

tiktok.author.description: One profile (Apify authorMeta shape). Read from the A2UI stream: final state of each profile surface.
tiktok.author.extract:
author.{ "name": uniqueId, "nickName": nickname, "signature": signature, "avatar": avatar,
        "fans": fans, "following": following, "heart": heart, "profileUrl": $model.page.url }

tiktok.video.description: FAST: one record per item of the profile's network-sourced /feed (the page's own item_list XHRs), capped at the run's resultsPerPage.

tiktok.video.detail.description: FALLBACK (feed unavailable): final state of each opened video surface, joined to its grid tile on the last profile surface.

back.intent: Go back to the previous page
Go back to the previous page
Go back to the previous page

net.select:
itemList.{ "id": id, "desc": desc, "createTime": createTime, "stats": stats, "music": music.title,
    "duration": video.duration, "cover": video.cover, "hashtags": [textExtra.hashtagName], "author": author.uniqueId }

openVideo.intent: Click the video thumbnail in the profile grid whose link contains {{id}}

loadMore.intent: Scroll the profile's video grid down so more thumbnails load

back.intent: Go back to the previous page
Close the video (✕ at the top-left of the player) to return to the profile grid

interrupted.description: An interrupt view is over the page: press its `dismiss` button (A2UI action), then resume.

idle.description: Waiting for the control surface's `start` event (A2UI action from any client).

profileUnit.description: Unit `profile:<handle>`; already-completed units (ledger) are skipped — reruns are idempotent.

awaitProfile.description: Branch on which state the page is actually in: profile, not found, or private.

loadGrid.description: Dispatch the A2UI `loadMore` action until enough tiles are projected or the grid stops growing.

params.text: loadMore gave up; continuing with the tiles we have

gridLoaded.description: Prefer the network feed (one emit, no navigation); fall back to opening each video.

params.text: {{ handle }}: feed unavailable — opening videos (slow path)

syncFeed.description: Response bodies are parsed asynchronously: let the feed catch up with the rendered tiles, then emit once.

params.text: feed lagging tiles; emitting what was captured

videoFailed.description: Isolate the failure to this unit, then get back to a known state.

provenance.derivedFrom: fixtures/tiktok-mock (mirrors tiktok.com data-e2e contract); 2 samples per view
provenance.refinement: flows/tiktok-profile/*.patch.json — vision review of out/derive/*.annotated.png + canvas frames

refine.notes: DivNumber group duplicates the three stat counters; '…-count' strongs pair with static labels Following/Followers/Likes. Verified against tiktok.com: user-title is the display name, user-subtitle the @handle.

undefined-count sits under the bookmark icon, i.e. collectCount; byline = nickname · date; the clip duration is only rendered into the <canvas> frame, not the DOM — source it from __UNIVERSAL_DATA_FOR_REHYDRATION__ instead. The canvas frame animates (like a playing <video>), so it is dropped from the live surface: streaming it would keep the model from ever settling.
